parallels.note: He made darkness a shelter around himself: gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

translations.web: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
translations.bsb: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
translations.kjv: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
translations.asv: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
